import.title: Import tasks
import.intro: Paste a list or a table, or choose a file. One task per line, with or without bullets, numbers or checkboxes; indented items become a checklist, headings start a column, and ticked items go to the last column. Tables from a spreadsheet, CSV or Markdown, and KanbanCord board files, work too.

suggestions.title: Suggestion for this board
suggestions.labelsTags: Several tasks start with tags like {examples}. Labels can do that for you, in colour, and let you filter the board by them.
suggestions.labelsColumns: Columns like {examples} sort tasks into categories. Labels can do that instead, so columns can show how far each task is, and you can filter by them.
suggestions.priorities: Several tasks are marked {examples}. Priorities can do that for you, and let you filter the board by them.
suggestions.dueDates: Several tasks have deadlines written in them, like {examples}. Due dates can do that for you, and remind the people on a task before it is due.
suggestions.assigneesNames: Several tasks say who does them, like {examples}. Assignees can do that for you, and the people assigned hear about their tasks.
suggestions.assigneesColumns: Columns like {examples} are named after people. Assignees can show who does what, so columns can show how far each task is.
suggestions.askManager: Someone with {manageServer} can switch this on, in {where} or with /kanbancord features in Discord.
suggestions.askBoardEditor: This is off for this board only. Someone who can edit the board can switch it on in {where}.
